overview.en: Its range lies farther north than that of the Common Black Widow, Latrodectus mactans.
overview.fr: Son aire remonte plus au nord que celle de la veuve noire commune, Latrodectus mactans.

identification.en: Females are glossy dark, with variable red spots on the upper abdomen.
identification.fr: Les femelles sont sombres et luisantes, avec des taches rouges dorsales variables.

habitat.en: In Quebec, records are from a few southern localities.
habitat.fr: Au Québec, elle n’est signalée que dans quelques localités du sud.

diet.en: It is a web-building predator; species-specific prey details are limited.
diet.fr: C’est une prédatrice qui tisse une toile; les détails sur ses proies restent limités.

behavior.en: A Quebec paper describes it as discreet and not inclined to bite.
behavior.fr: Un article québécois la décrit comme discrète et peu encline à mordre.

reproduction.en: A Quebec female with three egg sacs confirmed local reproduction.
reproduction.fr: Une femelle québécoise accompagnée de trois cocons a confirmé la reproduction locale.

ecology.en: It is distinct from L. mactans and shares its genus with L. geometricus, L. hasselti and L. katipo.
ecology.fr: Elle se distingue de L. mactans et partage son genre avec L. geometricus, L. hasselti et L. katipo.

conservation.en: In 2021, four Quebec localities were known; this is not a global threat assessment.
conservation.fr: En 2021, quatre localités québécoises étaient connues; ce chiffre n’est pas une évaluation mondiale du risque.

uncertainties: The Quebec occurrence count is specifically the count reported in 2021 and may have changed since publication.
The article notes that genital features alone may not distinguish this species from related North American Latrodectus; pattern and range are important context.
No global conservation assessment was identified in the sources consulted.
review_note: Cross-checked a bilingual Quebec arachnology paper, a 2025 OQLF terminology record and Health Canada. Kept the locality count date-bound and distinguished local records from global conservation status.
